articles.title: Protecting Our Environment
articles.content: Today, our environment is in danger. The air, water and land are all polluted. Cars and factories produce too much smoke. Rivers are full of dirty water. People throw rubbish everywhere. Animals are losing their homes. We must do something to protect our environment. First, we should walk or ride bikes more often. Second, we should not throw rubbish into rivers. Third, we should plant more trees. We can also save water and electricity at home. Everyone can help. If we all work together, our world will become greener and more beautiful. The earth is our only home. Let's protect it!
articles.translation: 今天，我们的环境处于危险之中。空气、水和土地都被污染了。汽车和工厂排放太多烟雾。河流里满是脏水。人们到处乱扔垃圾。动物们正在失去家园。我们必须采取行动保护环境。首先，我们应该多走路或骑自行车。其次，我们不应该把垃圾扔进河里。第三，我们应该多种树。我们也可以在家节约水电。每个人都能帮上忙。如果我们一起努力，我们的世界会变得更绿色更美丽。地球是我们唯一的家园。让我们保护它！

questions.q: What is the main problem in the passage?
Which is NOT a way to protect the environment?
What does the writer want us to do?

articles.title: How to Learn English Well
articles.content: Many students think English is difficult. But if you use good methods, you can learn it well. First, listen to English every day. You can listen to English songs or watch English movies. Second, speak English as much as possible. Don't be afraid of making mistakes. The more you speak, the better you get. Third, read English stories. Reading helps you build vocabulary and improve your understanding. Fourth, write something in English every day. Even a few sentences will help. Finally, practice makes perfect. Don't give up when you find it hard. Remember, learning a language takes time. If you keep working hard, you will succeed.
articles.translation: 许多学生认为英语很难。但是如果你使用好的方法，你可以学好它。首先，每天听英语。你可以听英文歌或看英文电影。其次，尽可能多说英语。不要害怕犯错。说得越多，你就越好。第三，读英语故事。阅读能帮助你建立词汇量并提高理解力。第四，每天用英语写点东西。即使是几句话也有帮助。最后，熟能生巧。当你觉得难的时候不要放弃。记住，学一门语言需要时间。如果你坚持努力，你就会成功。

questions.q: How many ways does the writer mention to learn English?
What should you NOT be afraid of when speaking English?
What does 'practice makes perfect' mean?

articles.title: The Power of Friendship
articles.content: Friends are an important part of our lives. A good friend can make us laugh when we are sad. A good friend can help us when we are in trouble. A good friend can share our happiness and our worries. I have a best friend named Lily. We have been friends for five years. We met in primary school. At first, I was a shy boy and made few friends. But Lily was kind to me. She invited me to play with her. Slowly, I became more confident. Now we share everything together. We study, eat lunch and play sports together. When I feel down, she always encourages me. Friendship is like a treasure. We should care for it and never let it go.
articles.translation: 朋友是我们生活中重要的一部分。一个好朋友能在我们难过时让我们笑。一个好朋友能在我们陷入困境时帮助我们。一个好朋友能分享我们的喜悦和忧虑。我有一个最好的朋友叫莉莉。我们已经做了五年朋友。我们在小学认识。起初，我是个害羞的男孩，几乎没有朋友。但莉莉对我很友好。她邀请我和她一起玩。慢慢地，我变得更自信了。现在我们一起分享一切。我们一起学习、吃午餐、做运动。当我情绪低落时，她总是鼓励我。友谊就像宝藏。我们应该珍惜它，永远不让它溜走。

questions.q: How long have the writer and Lily been friends?
What was the writer like at first?
What does the writer compare friendship to?

articles.title: My Future Job
articles.content: Everyone has dreams about their future job. When I was young, I wanted to be a singer. As I grew up, my dream changed. Now I want to be a doctor. Why? Two years ago, my grandfather got very sick. He stayed in the hospital for a long time. The doctors took good care of him. Finally, he got well. I was so happy. I saw how kind and skilled doctors were. I decided to become one in the future. Being a doctor is not easy. I need to study hard, especially science. I also need to be patient and brave. I know it will take many years to reach my goal. But I believe that if I keep trying, I will make my dream come true one day.
articles.translation: 每个人都对未来的职业有梦想。我小时候想当歌手。随着我长大，我的梦想变了。现在我想成为一名医生。为什么？两年前，我爷爷病得很重。他住了很长时间的院。医生们悉心照料他。最后他康复了。我非常高兴。我看到医生是多么善良和有技能。我决定将来成为一名医生。当医生不容易。我需要努力学习，尤其是科学。我也需要耐心和勇敢。我知道实现这个目标需要很多年。但我相信只要我坚持努力，总有一天我会让梦想成真。

questions.q: What was the writer's first dream?
Why does the writer want to be a doctor now?
What does the writer think being a doctor needs?

articles.title: The Internet Changes Our Lives
articles.content: The Internet has greatly changed our lives. Twenty years ago, only a few people used computers. Today, almost everyone has a smartphone. We can do so many things online. We can study, work, shop and chat with friends without leaving home. The Internet brings us a lot of useful information. It also makes communication faster and easier. However, the Internet also has problems. Some people spend too much time online and forget to talk to their family. Some students copy answers from the Internet instead of thinking by themselves. Online information is not always true. We must learn to use the Internet wisely. We should use it to help us learn and grow, not to waste our time. The Internet is a powerful tool. How we use it is up to us.
articles.translation: 互联网极大地改变了我们的生活。二十年前，只有少数人使用电脑。今天，几乎每个人都有智能手机。我们可以在网上做很多事情。我们可以足不出户地学习、工作、购物和与朋友聊天。互联网给我们带来很多有用的信息。它也使交流变得更快更容易。然而，互联网也有问题。有些人花太多时间上网，忘了和家人说话。有些学生从网上抄答案而不自己思考。网上的信息也不总是真实的。我们必须学会明智地使用互联网。我们应该用它帮助我们学习和成长，而不是浪费时间。互联网是个强大的工具。如何使用它取决于我们。

questions.q: What can we do online according to the passage?
What is one problem of the Internet?
options: Some people use it too much

questions.q: What is the writer's main message?

articles.title: The Power of Reading
articles.content: Why should we read books in the age of smartphones? Some people say books are old and slow. They prefer short videos because videos are easy and fun. However, I believe reading is still very important. First, when we read, we use our brains to imagine the scenes and characters. This makes us think deeply, while videos do all the thinking for us. Second, books often have richer ideas than short videos. A great novel can teach us about love, courage and human nature in ways that a 30-second video never can. Third, reading helps us focus. Today, many young people cannot sit still for ten minutes. Reading trains our minds to be patient and calm. Of course, videos are not bad. They can also teach us things. But we should not give up books. The best students I know read both books and watch videos. They get the best of both worlds.
articles.translation: 在智能手机时代，我们为什么还要读书？有些人说书又老又慢。他们更喜欢短视频，因为视频又简单又有趣。然而，我认为阅读仍然非常重要。第一，我们读书时会用大脑想象场景和人物。这让我们深入思考，而视频替我们做了所有的思考。第二，书往往比短视频有更丰富的思想。一本伟大的小说可以以三十秒视频做不到的方式教我们爱、勇气和人性。第三，阅读帮我们集中注意力。今天，许多年轻人无法静坐十分钟。阅读训练我们的头脑变得耐心和平静。当然，视频也不坏。它们也能教我们东西。但我们不应该放弃书。我认识的最好的学生既读书也看视频。他们兼得二者之长。

questions.q: Why do some people prefer short videos to books?
According to the writer, what does reading help us do?
What is the writer's main idea?

articles.title: A Trip to Mount Tai
articles.content: Last summer, my family went to climb Mount Tai. We arrived at the foot of the mountain in the afternoon. The mountain looked tall and quiet. Around it stood many old pine trees. We started our climb at six in the evening. The path was long and full of stone steps. After two hours, my legs began to hurt and I wanted to give up. But Dad smiled and said, "The view from the top is worth every step." So I kept going. We climbed all night. At about four in the morning, we finally reached the top. Many other people were waiting there too. Soon the sky turned pink, then orange, and the sun slowly came up over the clouds. It was the most beautiful sight I had ever seen. I felt proud of myself for not giving up.
articles.translation: 去年夏天，我家去爬泰山。下午我们到达山脚下。山看上去高大而宁静。山周围立着许多古老的松树。我们晚上六点开始登山。路又长又满是石阶。两个小时后，我的腿开始疼，我想放弃。但爸爸笑着说："山顶的景色值得每一步。"于是我继续走。我们爬了一整夜。大约凌晨四点，我们终于到达山顶。许多其他人也在那里等待。很快，天空变成粉色，然后是橙色，太阳慢慢从云端升起。这是我见过的最美的景色。我为自己没有放弃感到自豪。

questions.q: When did the family start climbing?
Why did the writer want to give up?
What did the writer feel at the top?

articles.title: The Story of Tea
articles.content: Tea is one of the oldest drinks in the world. According to a famous legend, an ancient Chinese emperor was boiling water under a tea tree about five thousand years ago. A few leaves fell into his pot. The water turned a soft golden colour and gave off a nice smell. The emperor tasted it and was surprised by how good it was. Since then, the Chinese have been drinking tea. For many centuries, tea was used as medicine before it became a daily drink. In the seventeenth century, tea was brought to Europe by sea traders. The British people quickly fell in love with it and made afternoon tea a part of their daily life. Today, tea is enjoyed in almost every country. Different countries have their own ways of drinking tea. In Japan, the tea ceremony is a quiet art. In England, people add milk and sugar. In Morocco, tea is made with mint leaves. Yet in every country, sharing a cup of tea brings people closer.
articles.translation: 茶是世界上最古老的饮品之一。据一个著名的传说，大约五千年前，一位古代中国皇帝在一棵茶树下煮水。几片叶子掉进了他的锅里。水变成了柔和的金黄色，散发出香味。皇帝尝了尝，对它的味道感到惊讶。从那时起，中国人就开始喝茶了。许多个世纪以来，茶被用作药物，后来才成为日常饮品。十七世纪，海上商人把茶带到了欧洲。英国人很快爱上了茶，并将下午茶作为日常生活的一部分。今天，几乎每个国家都享用茶。不同的国家有自己的喝茶方式。在日本，茶道是一种安静的艺术。在英国，人们加牛奶和糖。在摩洛哥，茶用薄荷叶煮。然而在每个国家，分享一杯茶都能让人们更亲近。

questions.q: How did the emperor discover tea, according to the legend?
options: Tea leaves fell into his hot water
He bought it from a market
He was given tea by a friend

questions.q: Before becoming a daily drink, what was tea used as?
What is the main idea of the passage?
options: Tea has a long history and is loved around the world

articles.title: Helping Others Helps Ourselves
articles.content: Many young people today are very busy with school and exams. They feel they have no time to help others. However, doing volunteer work can change a person's life in many ways. First, when we help others, we learn new skills. A boy who teaches old people to use smartphones may also become a more patient teacher and better speaker. Second, helping others makes us happier. Studies show that when people give their time to help others, their brains release a special chemical that brings joy. Third, volunteer work can make us see the world differently. We may meet poor children, sick old people or homeless families. Their stories teach us to value what we have. Of course, school is important. But spending one or two hours a week helping others is not too much. Try it once and you will find that you also receive something valuable in return.
articles.translation: 今天，许多年轻人忙于上学和考试。他们觉得自己没有时间帮助别人。然而，做志愿者工作可以从多方面改变一个人的生活。首先，我们帮助别人时会学到新技能。一个教老年人使用智能手机的男孩，也可能成为更有耐心的老师和更好的演讲者。第二，帮助别人会让我们更快乐。研究表明，当人们花时间帮助别人时，大脑会释放一种带来快乐的特殊化学物质。第三，志愿者工作能让我们以不同的方式看待世界。我们可能会遇到贫困的孩子、生病的老人或无家可归的家庭。他们的故事教我们珍惜自己所拥有的。当然，学习很重要。但每周花一两个小时帮助别人并不多。试一次，你会发现你也得到了宝贵的回报。

questions.q: Why do many young people not do volunteer work?
options: They are too busy with school

questions.q: How can helping others change us?
options: It teaches us skills and brings joy

questions.q: What does the writer suggest?
options: Help others one or two hours a week

articles.title: How a Plane Flies
articles.content: How does something as heavy as a plane fly through the sky? The answer lies in two important ideas: speed and the shape of the wings. A plane's wings are not flat. They are flat on the bottom but curved on the top. When a plane moves forward fast, air flows over and under the wings. The air on top moves faster because it must travel a longer way. This faster-moving air has lower pressure. The slower air below the wing has higher pressure. The higher air below pushes the wing up. This force is called lift. To move forward fast, the plane uses powerful engines. Without enough speed, there is not enough lift, and the plane cannot fly. That is why planes need a long runway before they take off. Although flying looks like magic, it is really clever science working with the laws of nature.
articles.translation: 像飞机这样重的东西是怎么在天上飞的？答案在于两个重要的概念：速度和机翼的形状。飞机的机翼并不是平的。它们底部是平的，但顶部是弯曲的。飞机快速向前移动时，空气从机翼上下流过。上面的空气流得更快，因为要走更长的路。这种流动更快的空气压力更低。下面的较慢空气压力更高。下面较高的气压把机翼向上推。这种力叫做升力。为了快速向前移动，飞机使用强劲的发动机。没有足够的速度，就没有足够的升力，飞机无法飞行。这就是为什么飞机起飞前需要一条长长的跑道。虽然飞行看起来像魔法，但它实际上是智慧的科学与自然定律协作的结果。

questions.q: What two things help a plane fly?
What is lift?
options: The force that pushes the plane up

questions.q: Why do planes need a long runway?
options: To get enough speed for lift

articles.title: Marie Curie
articles.content: Marie Curie was one of the greatest scientists in history. She was born in Poland in 1867. As a child, Marie loved reading and learning. However, in those days, women in Poland were not allowed to go to university. Marie did not give up. She moved to Paris alone and studied science there. Life was hard. She often had little money and almost no warm clothes in winter. But she worked harder than anyone else. Together with her husband Pierre, Marie discovered two new chemical elements. She named one of them "polonium" after her home country. In 1903, she became the first woman to win the Nobel Prize. Eight years later, she won a second Nobel Prize, this time in chemistry. Marie did not become rich. She gave away most of her money to help science. She also worked closely with dangerous radioactive materials, which finally damaged her health. Marie Curie's life shows that hard work, courage and curiosity can change the world.
articles.translation: 玛丽·居里是历史上最伟大的科学家之一。她1867年生于波兰。小时候，玛丽就喜欢读书和学习。然而那时候，波兰的女性不被允许上大学。玛丽没有放弃。她独自一人去了巴黎，在那里学习科学。生活很艰难。她经常没什么钱，冬天几乎没有暖和的衣服。但她比任何人都更加努力。她和丈夫皮埃尔一起发现了两种新的化学元素。她把其中一种命名为"钋"以纪念她的祖国。1903年，她成为第一位获得诺贝尔奖的女性。八年后，她获得了第二个诺贝尔奖，这次是化学奖。玛丽并没有变得富有。她把大部分钱捐给了科学事业。她也长期接触危险的放射性物质，最终损害了她的健康。玛丽·居里的一生表明，努力、勇气和好奇心可以改变世界。

questions.q: Why did Marie move to Paris?
options: Because women couldn't go to university in Poland

questions.q: How many Nobel Prizes did she win?
What is the main message of the passage?
options: Hard work and courage can change the world

articles.title: Different Ways to Greet
articles.content: When you meet someone, what do you do? In China, people often nod or shake hands gently. In western countries, people shake hands more firmly and look the other person in the eye. In France and some other European countries, friends often kiss each other on the cheek when they meet. In Japan, people bow to each other. The deeper the bow, the more respect they show. In India, many people put their hands together and say "Namaste" to greet others. In some African countries, people clap their hands when they meet a guest. These different ways of greeting may seem strange to a foreign visitor. However, every greeting has the same simple meaning: "I'm happy to see you." When we travel to a new country, learning the local way to greet is the first step to making friends and showing respect.
articles.translation: 你和别人见面时会做什么？在中国，人们通常点头或轻轻握手。在西方国家，人们握手时握得更有力，并直视对方的眼睛。在法国和其他一些欧洲国家，朋友见面时常常互相亲吻脸颊。在日本，人们会鞠躬。鞠躬越深，表示越尊重。在印度，许多人会双手合十说"Namaste"来问候别人。在某些非洲国家，人们见到客人时会拍手。这些不同的问候方式对外国游客来说可能很奇怪。然而每种问候都有同样简单的含义："我很高兴见到你。"当我们去到一个新的国家旅行时，学习当地的问候方式是结交朋友和表示尊重的第一步。

questions.q: How do people greet in Japan?
What is the same meaning behind all greetings?
Why is it useful to learn local greetings?
options: To make friends and show respect

articles.title: Why Honey Bees Matter
articles.content: Honey bees are small, but they play a huge role in our world. Most people know that bees make honey, but few realize how important they are to our food. Bees fly from flower to flower drinking sweet juice. While doing so, they carry pollen between flowers. Without this pollen, plants cannot grow new fruits and seeds. About one third of the food we eat depends on bees. Apples, almonds, oranges, blueberries and many vegetables would all become rare without these tiny helpers. Sadly, the number of honey bees is falling. Some scientists believe that strong farm chemicals, lost forests and warmer weather are killing bees. If bees disappeared, the price of fruit and vegetables would rise sharply, and some plants might disappear forever. We can help by planting more flowers in gardens, using fewer chemicals, and supporting local farmers who care about bees. Saving bees is also saving ourselves.
articles.translation: 蜜蜂虽然小，却在我们的世界中扮演着巨大的角色。大多数人知道蜜蜂酿蜜，但很少有人意识到它们对我们的食物有多么重要。蜜蜂从一朵花飞到另一朵花喝甜汁。在此过程中，它们在花朵之间携带花粉。没有这些花粉，植物就不能长出新的果实和种子。我们吃的食物中大约三分之一依赖蜜蜂。苹果、杏仁、橙子、蓝莓和许多蔬菜，没有这些小帮手都将变得稀有。可悲的是，蜜蜂的数量正在下降。一些科学家认为，强力的农药、消失的森林和气候变暖正在杀死蜜蜂。如果蜜蜂消失，水果和蔬菜的价格会急剧上升，一些植物可能永远消失。我们可以通过在花园种更多的花、少使用化学品、支持关心蜜蜂的本地农民来帮忙。拯救蜜蜂也是在拯救我们自己。

questions.q: Why are bees important to our food?
What is one reason bees are dying?
What can people do to help bees?
options: Plant more flowers and use fewer chemicals

articles.title: My Grandma's Garden
articles.content: My grandma lives in a small village. The most beautiful place in her home is her garden behind the house. Every morning, she gets up early and waters her plants. She grows many things: tomatoes, beans, peppers and beautiful flowers. "A garden teaches you patience," she always says with a soft smile. Last summer, I stayed with her for three weeks. At first, I was bored and missed my phone games. Then Grandma asked me to help her in the garden. I pulled weeds, picked tomatoes and watered young plants. I got dirty and my back hurt. But after a few days, I started to enjoy the work. I watched a small green tomato slowly turn red. I saw bees fly from flower to flower. By the end of my visit, I understood Grandma's words. The garden was teaching me how to wait, how to work hard, and how to love simple things.
articles.translation: 我奶奶住在一个小村庄。她家最美的地方是房子后面的花园。每天早晨，她早起给植物浇水。她种了很多东西：番茄、豆子、辣椒和美丽的花。"花园教你耐心。"她总是带着柔和的微笑这样说。去年夏天我在她家住了三周。起初我觉得无聊，怀念我的手机游戏。后来奶奶让我去花园帮她。我拔草、摘番茄、给小苗浇水。我弄得满身脏，腰也疼。但几天之后，我开始享受这项工作。我看着一个小小的绿番茄慢慢变红。我看见蜜蜂在花朵间飞来飞去。访问结束时，我理解了奶奶的话。花园在教我如何等待、如何努力、如何热爱简单的事物。

questions.q: What does Grandma say a garden teaches?
How did the writer feel at first?
What did the writer learn from the garden?
options: How to wait, work hard and love simple things

articles.title: East and West: Family Dinners
articles.content: Family dinners are common around the world, but the way they are held can be quite different in eastern and western countries. In a typical Chinese family dinner, all the dishes are placed in the middle of the table. Family members share the food together. People take a little bit from each plate. Older people are often served first as a sign of respect. Conversation is warm but usually quiet. In a typical American family dinner, each person has his or her own plate with a separate amount of food. Family members talk a lot during the meal. Children are often asked about their school day and are encouraged to share their opinions. Both styles are wonderful in their own way. The Chinese style shows the value of sharing and respect. The western style shows the value of individuality and open talk. As the world becomes more connected, more families now mix the two styles. They enjoy shared food and free conversation at the same table.
articles.translation: 家庭晚餐在世界各地都很普遍，但举行的方式在东方和西方国家可能截然不同。在典型的中国家庭晚餐中，所有的菜都放在桌子中间。家庭成员一起分享食物。每个人从每盘菜中夹一点。年长的人通常先被服务，作为一种尊重。交谈温暖但通常较安静。在典型的美国家庭晚餐中，每个人都有自己的盘子，盛着分开的食物。家人们在用餐时聊得很多。孩子们经常被问起他们的学校生活，并被鼓励分享自己的观点。两种风格各自都很美。中式风格体现了分享和尊重的价值。西式风格体现了个性和开放交流的价值。随着世界越来越紧密相连，更多家庭现在把两种风格混合起来。他们在同一张桌子上享受共同的食物和自由的交谈。
